capabilities.capability: S1 - Singing engine capability schema + catalogue filtering.
completion_evidence: automated repository contract/preflight evidence on the implementation head

slices.objective: Implement the explicitly documented S1 Singing engine capability schema and catalogue filtering so singing compatibility is represented independently from ordinary TTS cloning support.
acceptance: Singing capability flags are represented explicitly in the engine/model schema.
Catalogue filtering can distinguish singing-compatible engines from ordinary TTS/voice-cloning support.
Existing speech capability behavior remains backward compatible.
Repository-native automated tests cover the new schema/filter behavior.

capabilities.capability: S2 - Singing project/input data model: the documented on-disk project layout for a singing job, created safely and deterministically.
completion_evidence: docs/projects/singing-mode.md S2 checklist state and the 'Project / batch artifacts' layout

slices.objective: Add backend/services/singing_project.py with one pure function, singing_project_paths(project_id: str) -> dict[str, str], returning the documented singing project layout as relative POSIX paths (source/, analysis/, voice/, renders/, metadata/, logs/ and the named artifact files) and returning an empty dict for any project id that is empty, whitespace-only, absolute or could escape the project root (the function is total and never raises). The function touches no filesystem; creating the directories is a later slice.
acceptance: the returned paths match exactly the directories and artifact file names documented under 'Project / batch artifacts'
every returned path is relative, uses forward slashes and begins with the validated project id
an empty, absolute, dot-segment, separator-containing or whitespace-only project id returns an empty dict
the function performs no filesystem access and the same input always returns the same dict
repository-native tests cover the layout and every rejection case, and no existing speech behavior changes
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.
